name: open-sign-flip
title: Open Sign Flip
description: A shop sign hangs from two cords and swings in, then flips from "TUTUP" to "BUKA" and settles with a little sway. The opening hours slide up below it. Shop, both words and the hours are variables.
useWhen: Announcing a shop is open, newly opened or open on new hours.
A grand opening or a "buka lagi" after a break.
avoidWhen: A store address or map: use store-location-pin.
A countdown to the opening: use event-countdown-clock.
author: Mosio

source.technique: card flip and a damped pendulum swing: a hanging object changing state

variables.label: Shop name
variables.description: Small line at the top of the sign.

variables.label: Closed word
variables.description: Word on the front of the sign.

variables.label: Open word
variables.description: Word on the back of the sign, shown after the flip.

variables.label: Days
variables.description: Small line above the hours. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: The open side of the sign: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
